notes: Seed entries for reusable AskCrystal metaobjects.
These entries are safe defaults for storefront education and agent grounding.
Operational claims should stay generic unless verified by store operations.

fields.name: Amethyst
fields.short_meaning: A calming purple quartz traditionally associated with quieting mental noise, dreamwork, and intuitive reflection.
fields.care_notes: Avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged direct sunlight. Clean gently with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with selenite for clearing and rose quartz for emotional softness.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Rose Quartz
fields.short_meaning: A gentle pink quartz traditionally linked with self-love, emotional softness, and heart-centered repair.
fields.care_notes: Keep away from harsh chemicals and extended sun exposure. Wipe with a soft cloth after wear.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with amethyst for calm or clear quartz for amplifying a heart intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Black Tourmaline
fields.short_meaning: A grounding black crystal traditionally used for energetic boundaries, protection, and steadiness.
fields.care_notes: Avoid soaking. Clean with a soft dry cloth and store separately from softer stones.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for focus or selenite for regular energetic clearing.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Clear Quartz
fields.short_meaning: A versatile crystal traditionally associated with clarity, amplification, and intention-setting.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft cloth. Avoid impact against harder surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs with most crystals when you want to clarify or strengthen an intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Citrine
fields.short_meaning: A warm golden quartz traditionally connected with confidence, creative momentum, and abundance mindset.
fields.care_notes: Avoid prolonged direct sunlight to protect color. Clean with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with green aventurine for opportunity work or tiger's eye for practical confidence.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Selenite
fields.short_meaning: A luminous crystal traditionally used for cleansing, spaciousness, and creating a calm ritual field.
fields.care_notes: Keep dry. Selenite is soft and can dissolve or flake with water exposure.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with almost any crystal as a cleansing companion.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice. Keep selenite dry.

fields.name: Moonstone
fields.short_meaning: A softly luminous feldspar traditionally associated with emotional rhythm, intuition, and new beginnings.
fields.care_notes: Avoid harsh chemicals and hard impact. Wipe gently with a soft cloth after wear.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with rose quartz for emotional gentleness or amethyst for dreamwork.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Lapis Lazuli
fields.short_meaning: A deep blue stone traditionally linked with truth, inner authority, and thoughtful communication.
fields.care_notes: Avoid soaking, ultrasonic cleaners, and harsh chemicals. Clean with a soft dry cloth.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for clarity or amethyst for reflective insight.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Tiger's Eye
fields.short_meaning: A golden-brown stone traditionally associated with courage, grounded action, and practical confidence.
fields.care_notes: Clean with a soft cloth and avoid harsh chemicals. Store separately to prevent scratches.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with citrine for momentum or black tourmaline for stronger boundaries.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Green Aventurine
fields.short_meaning: A green quartzite traditionally connected with opportunity, optimism, and gentle heart renewal.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals and abrasive surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with citrine for abundance work or rose quartz for heart softness.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.name: Copper
fields.short_meaning: A warm conductive metal traditionally associated with circulation of intention, creative confidence, and everyday energetic connection.
fields.care_notes: Keep dry when possible. Wipe with a soft cloth after wear and store away from harsh chemicals or abrasive surfaces.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with clear quartz for clarity, citrine for momentum, or rose quartz for a softer heart-led intention.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice. Avoid if you have a known copper sensitivity.

fields.name: Agate
fields.short_meaning: A banded chalcedony traditionally associated with steady grounding, emotional balance, and calm focus.
fields.care_notes: Clean gently with a soft dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals, hard impact, and prolonged soaking.
fields.pairing_notes: Pairs well with black tourmaline for stronger grounding or rose quartz for a softer emotional reset.
fields.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Not medical advice.

fields.title: Sleep Release Ritual
steps: Hold the crystal for three slow breaths
Name one thought you are ready to release
Place the crystal near your bedside before sleep

fields.title: Self-Love Reset Ritual
steps: Place one hand over your heart
Hold the crystal and take three steady breaths
Speak one kind sentence to yourself

fields.title: Boundary Setting Ritual
steps: Hold the crystal near your lower body
Name one boundary you are choosing today
Carry or place the crystal where you need steadiness
